_note: WorkBuddy (Tencent office agent, ex-CodeBuddy) has no documented MCP config path. Two options: (a) if it supports MCP, copy this block into its MCP settings and confirm the key name with the WorkBuddy docs; (b) if it does NOT support MCP, rely on the universal layers instead: install the git post-commit hook (multi-agent/adapters/git/install.sh) so every commit writes the flag, and use a scheduled drain_requeue.py.
